goal: Build a local-first audio microdrama authoring product that turns narrative intent into a provider-ready beat plan, an OpenMontage production package, and an editable ANIMILL visual launch timeline.
definition_of_done: A creator can choose an archetype and edit voice, music, ambience, SFX, silence, and transition beats without using a provider.
Local preview makes timing and energy understandable without being misrepresented as a finished master.
The same canonical project produces OpenMontage artifacts and a production-safe ANIMILL handoff.
Unavailable providers remain visibly locked and are never silently substituted.
A fresh browser test proves NANA to ANIMILL continuity.
constraints: Local-first authoring must work with no API keys
Provider choice and cost must remain explicit
ANIMILL is the visual authoring consumer
assumptions: Audio microdrama plus visual launch kit is the first wedge
Browser speech and Web Audio are preview-only
FFmpeg remains the first deterministic mix engine
unknowns: Which configured generation provider the creator will approve first
Whether the first release target is a dialogue microdrama or song campaign
Required stem-editing depth after the first generated master

problem_formulations.question: What path turns an idea into an editable audio and visual launch package?
What would make this another fake generator frontend?
What must ANIMILL and OpenMontage receive for the audio plan to remain useful downstream?

decisive_evidence: Fresh creator input reaches ANIMILL and OpenMontage from one canonical audio project.
cost_risk: Real generation remains blocked until a provider is configured and approved.

solution_equation: NANA = narrative promise + timed beat grid + honest local preview + provider/provenance contract + OpenMontage package + ANIMILL launch kit + verified master

modules.outcome: Creator can structure and edit the full audio event vocabulary.
interface_contract: All timing is bounded to project duration
Every beat has lane, intent, energy, provider, rights, and approval fields
acceptance: Unit test normalizes a fresh archetype into six ordered lanes
fallback: Start with an empty voice beat

modules.outcome: Every NANA timeline item directly edits its canonical beat.
inputs: clip body or left/right edge pointer drag
outputs: bounded start, duration, and optional lane change reflected in both timeline and beat editor
interface_contract: All changes remain within the project duration
acceptance: Fresh browser test drags and resizes a real voice clip and observes changed beat fields
fallback: Numeric beat fields remain available below the timeline

modules.outcome: Every voice beat can select any local speech voice exposed by the device.
inputs: browser speech voice inventory and per-beat selection
outputs: persisted voiceURI and voiceName consumed by local preview
interface_contract: Voice metadata survives OpenMontage handoff normalization
acceptance: Fresh browser test exposes two injected device voices plus default, persists a selection, and unit test preserves the selection
fallback: Use the operating-system default voice when no inventory is exposed

modules.outcome: Creator can audition timing without provider cost.
outputs: browser/OS voice and Web Audio timing preview
interface_contract: Preview is labeled local and never exported as a master
acceptance: Transport schedules lane-specific events and can stop them
fallback: Visual playhead remains available when audio output is blocked

modules.outcome: Available and locked providers are visible without exposing secrets.
interface_contract: No generation call occurs from readiness inspection
acceptance: Current page reports local preview/FFmpeg ready and unconfigured providers locked

modules.outcome: Audio intent becomes a governed production workspace.
interface_contract: Generation executed remains false until a provider call succeeds
acceptance: Fresh temporary-workspace test reads the generated ANIMILL artifact

modules.outcome: Voice beats become an editable visual launch timeline.
interface_contract: Generated blocks remain exact for both production renderers
acceptance: Browser test chooses Talkback and arrives in ANIMILL with the correct scene
fallback: Write animill-project.json in the OpenMontage package

modules.outcome: Approved providers turn selected beats into provenance-bearing stems.
interface_contract: Every output records cost and rights
acceptance: Fresh single-beat provider sample is approved and persisted

modules.outcome: Stems produce a loudness-checked master and synchronized visual package.
interface_contract: FFmpeg mix timing follows the canonical beat plan
acceptance: Fresh multi-stem mix passes probe and listening review

integration_checks: Edit a fresh archetype and transfer it into ANIMILL
Move and resize a beat directly on the timeline and verify the editor fields
Select a non-default device voice and verify it survives save and handoff normalization
Write and reopen OpenMontage audio artifacts
Verify generated ANIMILL project is exact for HyperFrames and Remotion
Reject or lock unavailable provider actions
risks: Browser speech voices vary by host and are preview-only
A full multitrack waveform editor would expand scope before a real stem exists
next_unlocked_capability: Connect one explicitly approved voice or music provider sample, persist its provenance, then mix it through the existing FFmpeg path.
